blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Office of the Ombudsman on Thursday said it ordered the filing of graft charges against three former officials of the Land Bank of the Philippines and a businessman over alleged irregularities in the loans extended to American Boulevard Trading Corp. (ABTC). In a statement, the ombudsman said it ordered the filing of charges against the former LandBank first vice president Lolita Silva, former assistant vice president Danilo Dayanghirang, former account officer Ronaldo Robles, as well as ABTC president and chair Alberto Ching. “[With] all the material elements of Section 3(e) of [Republic Act No. 3019 or the Anti-Graft and […]...
